description.value:
You are as much an entertainer as any musician or circus act, just with combat as your art form. Trained to turn a fight into a spectacle a crowd will pay to watch, you've bled for cheering audiences in arenas both licensed and illegal.

Wherever there's a pit or a ring that features combat as entertainment, you can find work — and more than a few strangers recognize your name, or at least your fighting style, from a bout they once watched.

system.equipment: A trophy earned through competition, clothing suitable to your profession, and a belt pouch containing 150 credits.
